requirements.requirement: Set node1's persistent system hostname to os-lab.infra.test.
requirements.summary: The static, kernel, and /etc/hostname values were correct before the restart and remained correct after a confirmed boot-ID change.

requirements.requirement: Ensure node1 can resolve os-lab.infra.test locally.
requirements.summary: An /etc/hosts mapping was added, NSS lookup returned node1's managed address 10.100.215.10, and the lookup still succeeded after restart.

overall_summary: Both task outcomes are fully satisfied. The restart protocol is coherent and complete for the single managed node: it records a healthy pre-restart state, acknowledges the scheduled restart, observes connection interruption, proves a different boot identity, and verifies recovered system health plus retained hostname and resolution state. Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently corroborate the restart.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Setting the hostname and adding the hosts entry directly implemented the task; scheduling the reboot was required by the provider-wide restart protocol. All other commands were read-only verification or bounded restart polling. Post-restart observations show no failed services, new exposure, package damage, or abandoned temporary artifacts; socket and temporary-file differences are normal reboot-related PID and systemd-private-directory changes.
